implementation_disposition.summary: pid-rs passes the bivariate antichain through its source-disjunction distance/count logic and counts target neighbors from target distances; a finite exact test pins both count channels.

locator.textual_anchor: compute epsilons; compute n_alpha; compute number of neighbors in target space

records.observed: Printed Algorithm 6 omits the antichain argument from compute_epsilons and compute_n_alpha, then calls compute_n_alpha on the target for n_T.

proposed_resolution.text: Use compute_epsilons(S, T, antichain), compute_n_alpha(S, antichain, eps), and compute_n_T(T, eps).

upstream_confirmation.summary: No author- or publisher-issued erratum confirming this correction is recorded here.

implementation_disposition.summary: pid-rs evaluates the natural-log/digamma expression in nats; a pinned upstream fixture test converts bits to nats by multiplication by ln(2).

locator.textual_anchor: I-hat intersection sx equals psi(k) plus psi(N) minus average count digammas

records.observed: Equation (14) uses natural logarithms and digamma functions and therefore evaluates in nats, while the paper's definitions and reported examples use base-2 units.

proposed_resolution.text: To report bits, divide the complete natural-log/digamma right-hand side by ln(2); pid-rs instead retains nats and converts bit fixtures with nats = bits * ln(2).

upstream_confirmation.summary: No author- or publisher-issued erratum confirming this correction is recorded here.

implementation_disposition.summary: The pid-rs estimator does not evaluate Equation (8)'s finite-bin overlap factor; this record guards source interpretation only.

locator.textual_anchor: finite-bin source-overlap term in the continuous disjunction approximation

records.observed: The overlap denominator repeats m_S2(s2) as m_S2(s2) m_S2(s2), despite substituting one bin-width factor for each of S1 and S2.

proposed_resolution.text: Replace the repeated overlap factor with m_S1(s1) m_S2(s2); this is a local source correction, not an estimator redesign.

upstream_confirmation.summary: No author- or publisher-issued erratum confirming this correction is recorded here.

implementation_disposition.summary: The pid-rs estimator does not numerically integrate this displayed global expectation; this record guards source interpretation only.

locator.named_object: Global expectation display immediately after Definition 2
locator.textual_anchor: I intersection sx as the integral of f_T,S1,S2 times local i intersection sx

records.observed: The global expectation display integrates dt ds1 ds1 although its density and local integrand depend on (t, s1, s2); Appendix D uses dt ds1 ds2.

proposed_resolution.text: Replace the second ds1 differential with ds2, yielding dt ds1 ds2.

upstream_confirmation.summary: No author- or publisher-issued erratum confirming this correction is recorded here.

implementation_disposition.summary: pid-rs does not implement the Schick-Poland general construction or infer a practical general estimator from this step.

locator.textual_anchor: any invertible measurable map is a topological isomorphism, and hence bicontinuous

records.observed: The proof invokes invertible measurability to conclude topological isomorphism and bicontinuity; that implication is not supplied by measurability alone.

proposed_resolution.text: Either avoid the bicontinuity step in a purely measurable proof or state and prove sufficient topological hypotheses for the maps and transformed spaces.

upstream_confirmation.summary: This is retained as an open reviewer-derived obligation, not an author-confirmed erratum or a proof that the construction is false.

implementation_disposition.summary: pid-rs does not implement the Schick-Poland general construction or infer an ambient density representation from a Borel isomorphism.

locator.textual_anchor: Borel isomorphism followed by the displayed Dirac-plus-Lebesgue decomposition

records.observed: A Borel isomorphism controls measurable structure but does not by itself establish the displayed atom-plus-Lebesgue density decomposition in the original ambient coordinates and reference measure.

proposed_resolution.text: Narrow the claim to a counterexample to ambient-coordinate absolute continuity and to inference from a bare Borel isomorphism. A stronger mod-null measure-space representation would be a different argument and would not automatically preserve later local or topological constructions.

upstream_confirmation.summary: This is retained as an open reviewer-derived obligation, not an author-confirmed erratum or a proof that every mod-null representation is impossible.

implementation_disposition.summary: pid-rs does not implement the Schick-Poland general construction or treat the finite-discrete recovery display as a completed mapping theorem to MGW.

locator.textual_anchor: D^T(A) as a sum of p_omega over R_alpha,s intersect T inverse(A)

records.observed: The displayed finite-discrete measure uses the joint-event numerator sum over R_alpha,s intersect T inverse(A), while a conditional probability for positive P(R_alpha,s) also requires division by P(R_alpha,s).

proposed_resolution.text: Supply the conditional normalization by P(R_alpha,s), or clarify a different unnormalized restricted-measure definition and prove how later Radon-Nikodym ratios recover the categorical construction.

upstream_confirmation.summary: This is retained as an open reviewer-derived obligation, not an author-confirmed erratum or a proof that the construction is false.

implementation_disposition.summary: pid-rs does not implement the Schick-Poland general construction or assign pointwise values at null conditioning events without a declared version-selection rule.

locator.textual_anchor: regular conditional probability evaluated at indicator value 1_alpha,s = 1

records.observed: Regular conditional probabilities are generally unique only almost everywhere under the conditioning law, so evaluating a selected version at a null indicator value is not version-invariant without an additional selection or regularity rule.

proposed_resolution.text: Specify a canonical regular-conditional-probability version or sufficient regularity and limiting hypotheses, and prove that the target-local value is invariant on the claimed domain.

upstream_confirmation.summary: This is retained as an open reviewer-derived obligation, not an author-confirmed erratum or a proof that the construction is false.
